name: meterforge-monorepo
description: MeterForge Usage Metering & Billing Engine Monorepo (Backend + Demo Frontend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
